nodes.name: opportunities-card.tsx
nodes.summary: Dashboard card component that displays a filtered, sorted list of opportunity-type leads, subscribing to a real-time notification stream to trigger refreshes.

nodes.name: OpportunitiesCard
nodes.summary: Renders a card wrapper around OpportunityList, filtering and sorting leads by opportunity type and subscribing to live notification events to auto-refresh.

nodes.name: opportunity-list.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a scrollable list of opportunity leads with per-row guest info, status badges, and click-through navigation for each lead.

nodes.name: OpportunityList
nodes.summary: Maps a list of leads into individual row items with guest name, phone, timestamp, status chip, and a badge indicating opportunity type.

nodes.name: pending-import-banner.tsx
nodes.summary: Banner component that polls the Airbnb import status from sessionStorage on mount and shows progress notifications until the import completes or errors out.

nodes.name: PendingImportBanner
nodes.summary: Reads a pending Airbnb import job from sessionStorage and runs a 4-second polling loop (up to 75 attempts) to check status, displaying toast notifications on completion or error.

nodes.name: property-combobox.tsx
nodes.summary: Searchable combobox input for selecting a property from a list, with filtered dropdown and keyboard-accessible item selection.

nodes.name: PropertyCombobox
nodes.summary: Controlled combobox that filters a property list by name query, shows a dropdown on focus, and fires onChange with the selected property id.

nodes.name: property-faq-manager.tsx
nodes.summary: Inline CRUD manager for a property's FAQ entries, supporting adding, editing on blur, and removing Q&A pairs with optimistic UI and API persistence.

nodes.name: PropertyFaqManager
nodes.summary: Manages a list of FAQ entries for a property: renders editable rows, calls api.faq.create/update/remove on user actions, and propagates changes via the onChange callback.

nodes.name: property-form-fields.tsx
nodes.summary: Large controlled form component rendering all editable fields for a property, including basic info, pricing, call handling mode, timezone, amenities, and seasonal pricing notes.

nodes.name: PropertyFormFields
nodes.summary: Renders ~30 labeled inputs covering all property fields (name, address, capacity, pricing, call handling, timezone, amenities, seasonal notes), forwarding changes via onChange callbacks.

nodes.name: property-form-section.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable card-based section wrapper for property form layouts, displaying a title, optional count badge, action slot, and help text above a children region.

nodes.name: PropertyFormSection
nodes.summary: Renders a Card with a header row (title + optional count + action), optional help text, and a content region for child form fields.

nodes.name: property-photo-carousel.tsx
nodes.summary: Image carousel component for displaying a property's photo gallery with previous/next navigation controls and lightbox expansion on click.

nodes.name: PropertyPhotoCarousel
nodes.summary: Renders an image carousel with index state, prev/next buttons, dot indicators, and a lightbox overlay triggered on image click.

nodes.name: property-photos-manager.tsx
nodes.summary: Admin photo manager component that handles uploading, reordering, setting cover, and removing property photos via the API, with a lightbox preview.

nodes.name: PropertyPhotosManager
nodes.summary: Manages property photos with upload (file input), reorder (move left/right), set-as-cover, and remove actions, using api.properties.uploadPhoto and providing a lightbox preview.

nodes.name: recovery-analytics-card.tsx
nodes.summary: Dashboard card that fetches and visualizes Busy Call Recovery funnel analytics including reply rates, menu selections, conversion metrics, and time-to-first-reply.

nodes.name: RecoveryAnalyticsCard
nodes.summary: Fetches recovery analytics data via useAsync and renders a funnel visualization with stat rows showing reply counts, conversion rates, and formatted duration metrics.

nodes.name: service-requests-table.tsx
nodes.summary: Table component for displaying active service/maintenance requests with completion actions, plus a collapsible panel for viewing completed requests.

nodes.name: ServiceRequestsTable
nodes.summary: Renders the service requests list with completion tracking state and a toggle button to show/hide the CompletedRequestsPanel drawer.

nodes.name: ai-training-section.tsx
nodes.summary: Settings section for managing AI negotiation rules: paste a pricing policy to parse into rules, review pending AI-extracted rules, and approve/edit/toggle/remove decided rules.

nodes.name: AiTrainingSection
nodes.summary: Full negotiation rules UI: parse policy text via api.negotiationRules.parse, review pending rules with property-scope selectors, approve/reject with discount-percent editing, and manage decided rules.

nodes.name: call-ownership-card.tsx
nodes.summary: Settings card for configuring per-property call handling mode, available hours, and timezone, with a property selector and save action.

nodes.name: CallOwnershipCard
nodes.summary: Lets the host select a property, then edit its call handling mode (AI/shared/host-only), available hours window, and timezone, saving changes via api.properties.update.

nodes.name: technicians-section.tsx
nodes.summary: Settings section for managing maintenance technicians: add new contacts with name, specialty, and phone, and remove existing ones per property.

nodes.name: TechniciansSection
nodes.summary: Renders a form to create new technicians via api.technicians.create and a list of existing ones with delete actions via api.technicians.remove.

nodes.name: sidebar-nav.tsx
nodes.summary: Responsive sidebar navigation component with desktop persistent rail, mobile slide-out drawer, dashboard links, user avatar, and a Talk-to-Mira voice test trigger.

nodes.name: SidebarNav
nodes.summary: Renders a desktop fixed sidebar and a mobile hamburger-triggered Sheet overlay, both containing NavLinks and the TalkToMiraDialog for the voice test feature.

nodes.name: stat-card.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable summary statistic card with an icon, numeric value, label, optional loading skeleton, and optional glass/interactive styling variants.

nodes.name: StatCard
nodes.summary: Renders a Card containing a colored icon box and a stat label/value pair, with optional loading skeleton and interactive/glass style modifiers.

nodes.name: status-chip.tsx
nodes.summary: Tiny presentational chip component that maps a status string and tone (positive/negative/neutral/warning) to a color-coded inline badge.

nodes.name: talk-to-mira-dialog.tsx
nodes.summary: Modal dialog that lets a host choose a property and launch the real-time voice test UI in a new browser window, using the current auth token.

nodes.name: TalkToMiraDialog
nodes.summary: Renders a dialog listing available properties; on confirm, calls openVoiceTest to construct the voice-test URL and open it in a new tab.

nodes.name: avatar.tsx
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui-style avatar component family: Avatar (with size variants), AvatarImage, AvatarFallback, AvatarBadge, AvatarGroup, and AvatarGroupCount.

nodes.name: badge.tsx
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Badge primitive with variant-based styling (default, secondary, destructive, outline) and a render-prop pattern for custom element composition.

nodes.name: button.tsx
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Button primitive exporting the Button component and buttonVariants cva helper, supporting default/destructive/outline/secondary/ghost/link variants and sm/default/lg/icon sizes.

nodes.name: calendar.tsx
nodes.summary: Full-featured date picker calendar built on react-day-picker v9, with tailored Tailwind class overrides, caption layout options, and a custom CalendarDayButton for focus management.

nodes.name: Calendar
nodes.summary: Wraps DayPicker with a comprehensive set of custom Tailwind classNames for all calendar sub-elements, supporting label/dropdown caption layouts and ghost/outline nav button variants.

nodes.name: card.tsx
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Card component family: Card (with size variants), CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, and CardFooter.

nodes.name: checkbox.tsx
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Checkbox primitive wrapping a native checkbox input with Tailwind styling and an indeterminate-state check icon.

nodes.name: definition-row.tsx
nodes.summary: Simple definition list row component rendering a label-value pair as a two-column flex row, used in detail panels and info cards.

nodes.name: dialog.tsx
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Dialog component family built on Radix UI: Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogPortal, DialogClose, DialogOverlay, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogFooter, DialogTitle, and DialogDescription.

nodes.name: dictation-input.tsx
nodes.summary: Speech-to-text enabled text input that integrates the useDictation hook with the Sarvam AI dictation API, appending transcribed words to the current value.

nodes.name: DictationInput
nodes.summary: Renders an input with a microphone toggle button; on dictation transcript events, appends the new word to the current value via onValueChange.
